name: Nostr Auth
description: Replaces username/password login with Nostr authentication for the web client. Viewers log in with a NIP-98 signed event (NIP-07 extension, NIP-46 bunker, or Amber), and access is authorized by the server owner's private Nostr allowlist. The plugin holds no owner-identity key material; the list keypair is dedicated and trivially rotatable.

versions.changelog: Initial release: NIP-98 login endpoint, private allowlist sync over relays, npub-based user provisioning, and dashboard configuration.
